# DropSpace 1.1

<!-- update-summary: Adds unified Island search, file collection, reusable results, a reference window and local Agent access; introduces an independent music window and Liquid Glass, with improved lyrics, offline replay and recovery. -->

## Since 1.0

- Search clipboard history, Temporary Space, pinned items, recent files and processing results from the Island. Opt in to collecting new files from chosen folders, reuse completed processing results, and open images or text in a shared reference window.
- Connect local Agents through the app's command catalog, PowerShell client or optional MCP bridge, with pairing and revocation managed in settings.
- Open an independent music window with shared playback, word-timed lyrics, translations, system volume and fullscreen. Improved artwork, responsive layouts and audio-responsive backgrounds accompany the music view.
- Choose configurable Liquid Glass for the Island, including Ink and Ultra-clear appearances, blur, refraction and refresh tiers. A music-window widget and optional Island hiding integrate both views.
- Match more songs across artist aliases, bilingual titles and recording versions. Improve candidate selection and word highlighting, and replay cached lyrics offline.
- Browse release history from About. Improve message clarity, download recovery, file previews, cancellation and background-task cleanup.

## Release and compatibility

1.1 promotes the functionality of `v1.1.0-beta.8` to Stable. App, installer and package version metadata are rebuilt for `1.1.0`; the Beta 8 release, tag and downloads remain available. Existing settings, data, models and independent CUDA component bytes are retained. Optional AI translation remains experimental and off by default.

Windows x64 build 20348 or later. Choose `DropSpaceSetup.exe`, portable `DropSpace.exe`, or `DropSpace-x64.msix`. Distribution retains the existing unsigned policy when signing is not configured. Portable updates use manual replacement.

At the owner's request, no new functional, browser, model or installation tests are run for this promotion. Compilation, package/resource inspection, version and checksum verification, and public Release/website synchronization are publication integrity checks. Historical validation limits remain; this promotion does not establish new runtime or model-quality coverage.

The previous Stable comparison baseline is `v1.0.0`; `v1.1.0-beta.8` is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release.
